facts.text: Under the Green & Gold Guarantee, Humboldt covers tuition and mandatory campus fees for eligible California undergraduates who have a Student Aid Index of 7000 or less.

sources.title: Green & Gold Guarantee | Cal Poly Humboldt
sources.quote: The Green & Gold Guarantee covers tuition and mandatory campus fees so you can focus on your future.

sources.title: Green & Gold Guarantee | Cal Poly Humboldt
sources.quote: Have a Student Aid Index of 7000 or less.

facts.text: All first-year students at Cal Poly Humboldt are required to live on campus for their first two years.

sources.title: Housing | Cal Poly Humboldt
sources.quote: Effective Fall 2025, all first-year students will be required to live on-campus for the first two years.
